scope: Food, Finance, and Homelab provider/domain planning

entries.maintenance_signal: Active release history; repository documents stock overview, shopping list, meal plan, and chores
entries.security_implications: Use only as a local design/test reference; its data model does not grant AEGIS authority
entries.dependency_implications: No runtime dependency or compatibility requirement
entries.recommended_reuse: Borrow stable stock/shopping-list state distinctions and edge cases for AEGIS Food tests; retain AEGIS canonical Principal/Space ownership

entries.maintenance_signal: Active self-hosted recipe/meal planner with REST API and shopping-list features
entries.security_implications: Recipe/ingredient data is not AEGIS canonical Pantry truth; do not import or expose it without explicit scope
entries.dependency_implications: AGPL and broad recipe scope make direct embedding disproportionate for the current Pantry minimum
entries.recommended_reuse: Study ingredient/list relationships only; keep AEGIS Food stable IDs and unknown-value semantics independent

entries.security_implications: Private ledger semantics remain Principal-scoped in AEGIS; external import behavior cannot replace canonical provenance
entries.dependency_implications: No dependency selected until an owner-controlled Actual adapter is actually needed
entries.recommended_reuse: Use import/reconciliation cases to expand AEGIS import tests; do not add the TypeScript application as a runtime dependency

entries.version_or_date_checked: repository README and importer docs checked 2026-09-07
entries.maintenance_signal: Separate importer application with CLI/API automation and CSV/CAMT support
entries.security_implications: Importer is a separate application; uploaded financial records and bearer tokens require an explicit boundary
entries.dependency_implications: AGPL and PHP service boundary are not justified for the current local CSV path
entries.recommended_reuse: Harvest file-coverage and import-report test cases; do not vendor, embed, or make it an AEGIS runtime dependency

entries.security_implications: Treat bank files as hostile input; bound file size, parse work, and validation before canonical writes
entries.dependency_implications: GPL-3.0-only requires license/product review before adding it to AEGIS
entries.recommended_reuse: Evaluate in an isolated parser experiment if OFX/QFX owner demand appears; CSV remains the current import path

entries.maintenance_signal: Established external network discovery tool with maintained upstream legal documentation
entries.security_implications: No model-supplied raw flags; bound scope/rate/privilege and keep discovered objects distinct from authorized canonical Hosts
entries.dependency_implications: Do not vendor or redistribute; an owner-installed executable may be considered only after product/license review
entries.recommended_reuse: Use typed profile/output concepts for a future owner-installed adapter; direct socket discovery remains the current safe path

decision: No OSS candidate is a current production dependency. AEGIS keeps canonical state, authorization, and provider boundaries independent of harvested designs.
